kai-docs: Quick draft for relnotes: embeddings service now enforces `min_tokens` by default to avoid noisy single-token vectors. Pasting short migration guidance + snippets. Need eyeballs on wording and broken links before I open PR.

marie-eng: good call. add compatibility info (runtime >= v1.4.2) and note that empty-string inputs return 400.

oliver-sdk: SDK versions: js >=1.1.0, py >=0.9.0. Show old vs new usage for both.

kai-docs: JS before/after:
```js
// old (implicit behavior)
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-x', input: ['a'] });

// new (explicit minTokens to preserve single-token outputs)
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-x', input: ['a'], options: { minTokens: 1 } });
```

kai-docs: Python snippet:
```py
# new explicit
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-x', input=['a'], options={'min_tokens': 1})
```

sara-product: add a short Why section explaining regression risk for search/rerank if teams rely on dropping single-token inputs. Recommend running a small regression set.

marie-eng: also include perf note: enabling min_tokens=1 keeps token accounting steady; default enforcement reduces noise and lowers average token transmission by ~9% on sampled datasets. Link to internal bench: https://internal.redwood/bench/emb-noise (internal only).

oliver-sdk: minor: in JS SDK the option is `minTokens` (camelCase) while REST uses `min_tokens`. Call that out.

kai-docs: done. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421 3Repro tests, snippets, and a small redirect to the model-catalog anchor which was broken.

deploy-bot: kai-docs pushed branch kai/emb-min-tokens -> staging/docs (CI: passing) :white_check_mark:

kai-docs: will merge after a copy edit from @marie-eng and then schedule publish Friday 07:30 PT. I'll post back with publish ts once live.

sara-product: after publish can we get a single-paragraph note for #support and the support template? I'll prepare customer outreach for teams with heavy rerank workloads.

marie-eng: closing for now. If linkcheck fails I'll open a follow-up thread.

kai-docs: thanks all, closing thread.
